message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are visible anywhere in the data acquisition or model code; data is passed through as raw arrays without validation.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded via a local function `load_cleaned_car_data` with no remote fetch, checksum verification, signed URLs, or authentication of any kind visible in the code.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation code contains no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: No pretrained weights or serialized models are loaded anywhere in this code; models are always instantiated and trained from scratch using scikit-learn constructors, so no integrity verification is performed or needed.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are used in any of the model training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, or any other adversarial attack/robustness testing framework anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While multiple metrics (R², MSE, MAE) and train/test/val splits are used, there is no hashing or signing of evaluation data, and the test set is passed into model.fit() alongside the training set (e.g., SVR concatenates train and test), meaning the held-out test set is not fully isolated from traini
No detected input sanitization: The inference path passes data directly from datasets to model.predict() and model.fit() with no shape, range, type, or schema validation on incoming inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: Model predictions (y_hat) are collected and written to CSV without any NaN guards, range checks, or sanity bounds on the output values.

No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses traditional ML regressors (KNN, LinearRegression, SVR, DecisionTree, RandomForest), not LLMs, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and not present.
